dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.overview: Here's what's happening at Way Studio today.

users.title: Clients
users.name: Name
users.addUserDescription: Fill in the details to register a new client.
users.deleteWarning: This client will be hidden from the clients list and their login will be disabled. Their history (sessions, items, subscriptions) is preserved and the client can be restored later.
users.deletedBanner: This client has been deleted. Their data is preserved and their login is disabled.
users.restoreConfirmDescription: This client will reappear in the active clients list and their login will be re-enabled.
users.resetPasswordWarning: This will generate a temporary password for the client. They'll need to set a new password the next time they log in. Any active sessions will be signed out.
users.resetPasswordDone: The password has been reset. Share the temporary password below with the client.
users.tempPasswordHint: The client will be asked to set a new password when they log in with this.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.addDescription: Log a new session against a client's subscription.
sessions.noActiveSubscriptions: No active subscriptions for this client
sessions.noClassesOnDate: No classes scheduled on this date
sessions.selectClassDateFirst: Pick a date first to see available classes
sessions.deleteWarning: Are you sure? This will permanently remove this session record. The subscription's remaining sessions/weight will NOT be restored.

packages.title: Packages
packages.description: Manage package types offered by the studio
packages.addDescription: Define a new package type for the studio.
packages.classTypeHelp: Which class this package unlocks. Multiple packages can belong to the same class (e.g. 4-session and 8-session tiers).
packages.deleteWarning: Are you sure? This will permanently remove this package type.
packages.emptyDescription: Add your first package to get started.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Track client package purchases and usage
subscriptions.addDescription: Assign a package to a client.
subscriptions.deleteWarning: Deleting this subscription will permanently remove all associated session logs and usage history. This cannot be undone.
subscriptions.deleteRecommendation: Consider editing the expiry date to a past date instead. This marks the subscription as expired while preserving the history.
subscriptions.emptyDescription: Add a subscription to assign a package to a client.
subscriptions.addSessionDescription: Create a session for this subscription.

tutors.title: Tutors
tutors.name: Name
tutors.addDescription: Add a new tutor to the studio.
tutors.deleteWarning: Are you sure? This will permanently remove this tutor.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.createSessionDescription: Book a client into this specific class. The class date and slot are pre-filled.
schedule.deleteWarning: Are you sure? This will remove this recurring class from the weekly schedule.
schedule.conflictError: Another class is already scheduled during this time slot
schedule.fullyBookedHint: Toggle this when the class has no remaining seats — it shows on the public schedule.
schedule.weeklyScheduleDesc: This week's sessions at a glance
schedule.overrideHint: These changes apply only to the week shown above. The class reverts to normal next week.
schedule.overrideCleared: Override cleared — class returned to normal
schedule.templateHint: Changes here apply every week going forward.
schedule.capacityHint: Max headcount for this class. Optional — leave blank for no cap.
schedule.noSessionsYetHint: Be the first to book a client into this class.
schedule.classCancelledBanner: This class is cancelled for this week.
schedule.fullyBookedBanner: This class is marked fully booked for this week.

items.title: Items
items.description: Track client artwork through the studio journey
items.addDescription: Register a new piece created by a client.
items.editDescription: Change the stage of this item.
items.search: Search by client name or ID...
items.createHint: The item will start at the "Drying" stage automatically.
items.createHintPC: The item will start at the "Glaze Firing" stage automatically. No subscription or clay type is needed.
items.advanceWarning: Are you sure you want to move this item to the next stage?
items.advanceGlazePrompt: Pick the glaze used for this firing — it will be saved on the item.
items.rewindWarning: Moving backward will refund any weight already deducted to the subscription and clear it from the item.
items.rewindAdminOnly: Only admins can move items backward.
items.discardRefundNote: Discarding will refund {{amount}} kg to the subscription. The weight stays saved on the item so it will be re-deducted automatically if you un-discard later.
items.undiscardRedeductWarning: Un-discarding will re-deduct the previously-saved {{amount}} kg from the subscription.
items.undiscardClearNote: Un-discarding to a pre-weighed stage will clear the recorded weight. No deduction occurs — the refund already happened when this item was discarded.
items.undiscardWeightPrompt: This item never had a weight recorded. Enter the final weight to deduct from the subscription as part of the un-discard.
items.deleteRefundNote: {{amount}} kg will be refunded to the subscription as part of the deletion.
items.deleteWarning: Are you sure? This will permanently remove this item record.
items.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Small vase with floral pattern
items.noActiveSubscriptions: No active subscriptions for this client
items.advanceWeightPrompt: Enter the current weight of this item to deduct from the subscription.
items.editFinalWeightPrompt: This stage skip moves past "Ready for Pickup" — enter the final weight to deduct from the subscription.
items.editGlazeTypePrompt: This stage skip moves past "Glaze Firing" — a glaze type is required.

pcItems.title: PC Items
pcItems.description: Track walk-in painting pieces (Painting on Ceramics)
pcItems.addDescription: Register a new walk-in painting piece. The item will start at the Glaze Firing stage.
pcItems.editDescription: Update the stage or description of this PC item.
pcItems.createHint: PC items skip drying and bisque firing — the client paints on a pre-made ceramic, then it heads straight to the kiln for glaze firing.
pcItems.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. White mug with blue flowers
pcItems.advanceSuccess: PC item advanced to next stage

auth.loginDescription: Sign in to Way Studio Admin
auth.newPasswordDescription: You must change your temporary password
auth.forgotPasswordDescription: Enter your email and we'll send you a verification code
auth.resetPasswordDescription: Enter the code sent to your email and choose a new password
auth.passwordResetSuccessDescription: Your password has been successfully reset
auth.passwordResetSuccessMessage: You can now sign in with your new password.

clayTypes.title: Clay Types
clayTypes.description: Manage the clay types selectable when creating Studio items.

clayTypes.editDescription: Renaming will update every existing item that uses this clay type.
clayTypes.name: Name
clayTypes.deleteWarning: Are you sure? Existing items that use this clay type will keep the value, but it won't be selectable for new items.
clayTypes.emptyDescription: Add a clay type to allow it as an option when creating Studio items.

classTypes.title: Class Types
classTypes.description: Manage the classes offered at the studio. Every package and scheduled slot belongs to a class.
classTypes.addDescription: Create a new class. Assign packages and schedule slots to it once created.
classTypes.editDescription: Rename a class or toggle whether it's currently offered.
classTypes.name: Name
classTypes.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional — a short blurb about this class
classTypes.isActiveHelp: Inactive classes stay linked to their existing packages and slots but won't appear in pickers for new ones.
classTypes.deleteWarning: This will fail if any packages or scheduled slots still point at this class. Retire it via the Active toggle instead if it has referencing rows.
classTypes.emptyDescription: Add a class so packages and schedule slots can be assigned to it.
classTypes.packagesInClassEmpty: No packages yet for this class.
classTypes.slotsForClassEmpty: No slots yet for this class.
